question: What was the gas consumption peak month for SME customers in 2013?
actual_sql:
SELECT
  ym.date AS year_month,
  SUM(ym.consumption) AS total_consumption
FROM yearmonth AS ym
JOIN customers AS c
  ON c.customer_id = ym.customer_id
WHERE c.segment = 'SME'
  AND ym.date LIKE '2013%'
GROUP BY ym.date
ORDER BY total_consumption DESC
expected_response: {"evidence": "Year 2013 can be presented as Between 201301 And 201312; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year; The 5th and 6th string of the date can refer to month."}
